input.subject: Re: Volunteering for the fall bake sale
input.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you so much for volunteering — and those samosas sound amazing! Aditi is lucky to have such a supportive mom.

You're all set to help out on the 24th. We'll get you on the official sign-up sheet on our end, so no need to fill out anything separately.

Great question about the nut-free table — I'm checking with the bake sale organizers on this year's plan and will get back to you as soon as I know. Either way, we'll make sure your samosas are clearly labeled!

Thanks again for jumping in!

Warmly,
Maria Chen
PTA President, Jefferson Elementary
